entries.en: See how it is? You write letters, and everyone ignores you. Force is the only thing people appreciate.
So how about if I kill Chairman Burns and finish this charade?
Please! I was trying to help you people!
Why not? What have we got to lose?
Since the chairman here decided that we didn't get reparations, we've got nothing left to live for!
But I've changed my mind! Seeing y-you all, it's c-clear that you all d-deserve...
You had your chance! Some L2s are nearly crippled from side effects of the implants, but you voted against reparations!
As if we'd trust the Alliance after what it did to us. Get them!
Yes! If you release me, I can take another look at the reparations request!
What, we're supposed to trust you?
I'm an L2, like you. Trust me. The commander can make sure that Burns follows through.
Sure, you promise us freedom and say everything will be fine, but as soon as we surrender, you'll double-cross us!
Absolutely. I had no idea that the L2 biotics were this desperate. If I had known...
The reparations will come. For whatever it's worth, I promise that.
What do you mean?
But people need to hear about what the government has done, and what it has failed to do!
People have heard. You've already accomplished that. You don't need to die for it.
People have already heard. You don't have to kill me to make your point!
You're right. I don't want to die. Maybe something will happen this time. We surrender.
I think I'll just kill you instead.
A Fifth Fleet cruiser will be by shortly to pick you up.
Then you weren't doing your job. Goodbye, Burns. A Fifth Fleet cruiser will pick you up.
A Fifth Fleet cruiser will be by shortly to pick you and the prisoners up.
Then you weren't doing your job. A Fifth Fleet cruiser will pick you and the prisoners up.
Let's not do anything we're all going to regret.
I'm giving you a choice. Put down your weapons and surrender.
You had one chance to get out of this alive. It's over.
Think about this. Burns is the one man who can help you!
I'm not promising to let you go. All I'm saying is that Burns will take another look. Right, Burns?
You're going to jail. But if you go peacefully, Burns will consider the reparations. Right, Burns?
If you die fighting, you'll get a lot of biotics killed, as well.
You've just made all L2 biotics look like terrorists. Think of what will happen to them.
If people think that all L2 biotics are violent extremists, what is that going to accomplish?
Not a problem.
No. You didn't.
Just doing my job.
Calm down.
Don't be stupid.
Take them down!
You don't have to die.
This is your last chance.
You need Burns!
I'm telling the truth.
This is as much as you get.
I didn't promise freedom.
Think, you idiot!
Don't you get it?
You're hurting your cause.
[Alarm blares.]
Intruders! Kill the hostage!
Damn. Let's move!
We should make haste if we are to save the chairman.
We need to hurry! They're going to kill him!
We've got to get in there before they execute the chairman!
That machine's keeping him alive.
Looks like that machine is keeping him alive.
It looks like that machine is keeping him alive.
I do not see any brain activity on the readouts. He is dead. This body is just an empty shell.
I'm not seeing any brain activity on the readouts. He's dead. This body is just an empty shell.
No brain activity. He's dead. This body is nothing but an empty shell.
